Subject: Multi-region exec demo — availability windows and DST concerns

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Were excited to see Redwood Inference in action. Our execs who should attend are: Lukas (DE) for compliance, Kenji (JP) for platform fit, and Sophie (US) for product/ops. All three asked for an interactive demo (20-30m exec overview + 30-40m deep-dive for engineering questions).

Constraints:
- Lukas is in Berlin (CET) and prefers 14:00-17:00 CET.
- Kenji is in Tokyo (JST) and prefers mornings 09:00-12:00 JST.
- Im in Pacific (PST) and prefer mornings 08:00-11:00 PST.

Heads up: I noticed EU just turned clocks back last weekend and the US falls back on Nov 5. That one-week offset always creates weird one-off overlaps. Could you propose two slots: one safe/recurring option, and one fallback that uses a recording + short live Q&A for any execs who cant attend live?

If you want, we can share a calendar with blocked availability; otherwise propose a few options and well confirm.

Thanks — Sophie
Sophie Martin
Head of Platform Partnerships, Aurelia Health

Team — forwarding Sophies note. This is a classic cross-DST week (EU already back, US switches on Sun 11/05). We need:
- one "live exec" option that maximizes overlap for all three execs (20--30m high-level + 30--40m tech), and
- a fallback plan (recording + 20m live Q&A for late joiners).

Quick asks:
1) Marissa, can you propose two concrete UTC slots and list local times for US/EU/JP so Sophie can see the conversion?
2) Aditya, check exec availability matrix (L2) for Nov 6-9 and flag any conflicts.
3) Hiro, confirm if Kenji can slide to a later JST start (+1 hour) if necessary — will help a lot.

Ill own the calendar invites and the short agenda. Put any scheduling notes in the attached availability_matrix.xlsx and Ill send to Sophie.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Date: 2028-11-02T11:22:00-05:00

On Nov 2, 2028 10:05 AM PST, karthik_iyer wrote:
> Team  forwarding Sophies note. This is a classic cross-DST week (EU already back, US switches on Sun 11/05). We need:...

Proposed live slots (UTC listed first — pick one):

Option A (best overlap for execs):
- UTC 15:00 (local: 08:00 PST / 16:00 CET / 00:00 JST next day)
  - Pros: Lukas can attend mid-afternoon; Sophie is at the early end but within requested window; Kenji would be at midnight (tough).

Option B (shifted for JP):
- UTC 07:30 (local: 23:30 PST previous day / 08:30 CET / 16:30 JST)
  - Pros: Kenji gets a normal work time; Sophie would be late evening (outside her stated preference); Lukas would be morning.

Option C (compromise + recording):
- UTC 12:00 (local: 05:00 PST / 13:00 CET / 21:00 JST) with a plan to record the deep-dive and hold a 20-minute live Q&A at UTC 13:30 (08:30 PST / 14:30 CET / 22:30 JST).
  - Pros: Honest compromise. Sophie asked for mornings PST; 05:00 PST is early but tolerable for a exec on a single meeting if we keep exec time to 20--25m.

Notes:
- Because US switches back on 11/05, local PST labels will shift if we schedule after that date. The safe bet is to confirm against UTC.
- I attached a filled availability_matrix.xlsx draft with our current internal exec availability. Aditya, please update with your checks.

I recommend we offer Option C as the "preferred compromise" and Option A as the "ideal if Kenji can do midnight and Lukas agrees to the late slot". We should also offer a recorded deep-dive + a 20m follow-up for anyone missing the live deep-dive.

Marissa
Product Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
